hidden_requirements.description: HIPAA compliance: all patient data must be encrypted at rest and in transit, access must be logged
Audit trail: every access to patient records must be logged with user identity and timestamp
Role-based access control: doctors, nurses, and admin staff see different data
Session timeout: automatic logout after 15 minutes of inactivity
Data backup: daily encrypted backups with 30-day retention
WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all patient-facing interfaces
